sections.heading: Chest pain can be serious
sections.content: Chest pain or pressure can come from the heart, lungs, digestion, muscles, anxiety, or other causes. It is not possible to safely diagnose the cause from chat alone.

sections.heading: Emergency warning signs
sections.content: Call emergency services for chest pain with pressure, shortness of breath, sweating, nausea, fainting, pain spreading to the arm, jaw, back, or shoulder, or symptoms that feel severe or unusual.

sections.heading: Non-emergency follow-up
sections.content: Mild or recurring chest discomfort still deserves clinician follow-up, especially with risk factors such as high blood pressure, diabetes, smoking, high cholesterol, or a family history of heart disease.
